The Green Russian is Stomp Under Foot's take on the Sovtek Green Russian Big Muff, with a fat, smooth low end, scooped mids and thick, wall-of-sound sustain. Volume, Tone and Sustain shape the classic Russian muff voice for rhythm and lead, delivering the dark, heavy character favoured for doom, stoner and modern rock. It works equally well on guitar and bass. Hand-built in the USA by Matt Pasquerella, whose workshop specialises in accurate Big Muff recreations.
